integrity: The proof states the full hypotheses and credits earlier nonequivariant and representation-theoretic inputs. Finite verification is corroboration, not a universal proof or external certification.
limitations: Rational coordinate-permutation cohomology only; no integral quotient acyclicity, quotient contractibility or equivariant homotopy splitting.
title: Symmetric-group cohomology and rationally acyclic quotients of injective-word moment-angle complexes
